about: Rolex Paris Masters 2026, main draw Mon 2 – Sun 8 Nov, La Défense Arena (Paris time; CET from 25 Oct). Scored rounds R32→F as PROPOSED (the 8 seeds bye the unscored R64); waiting on Martino's call. Round-by-day follows the 2025 edition (R1 Mon–Tue, R2 Tue–Wed, R3 Thu, QF Fri, SF Sat, F Sun). Every time is an early floor: pin each from the order of play the evening before.
